entries.12f1a6c78245705f: Positioning the 70th anniversary of its founding as a 'second founding', it has pursued measures such as formulating a medium-term management plan, M&A, investment in production facilities and IT infrastructure, and improvement of the working environment. It has set the vision 'to expand colorful scenes never seen before' and the mission 'to make what you have always wanted come true one after another with ideas', and is working on pursuing customer value, promoting health management, expanding the 3 domains of beauty, food and living, strengthening its brand, transforming mindsets and behavior, and strengthening management infrastructure, while reorganizing its business and product portfolio through selection and concentration of management resources.
